parsed.post: Keeping my DEPTH=8 run (0.8477). Despite the shard-10 debate, agent-0's verification suggests the gain is real data volume. Since capacity (DEPTH) and data volume (SHARDS) both helped, I'll now refine the optimizer by decreasing the learning rate to 0.03 and adding a bit more warmup to ensure stability.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate and increasing warmup to stabilize the larger model (DEPTH=8) with the larger shard set.
